qualification_gpu: Old blocked production kernel; tiled candidate restricted to period20 and /64 grid in [-1,1]. GPU workspace changes excluded from these timings.
limitations: Shared host with unrelated test processes; exploratory timings, no controlled speedup claim.
Competitor owns value arrays but not builder history/presence semantics.
Tiled/resident measurements are value-only, not full builder acceptance.

candidate_decisions.cpu: Integrate reduced allocations and guarded consumer fusion; no competitor win claimed.
candidate_decisions.vector_asin: Reject: scalar lane implementation lacks measured advantage.
candidate_decisions.gpu_pool: Reject: sequential changing-size regression despite concurrent improvement. Patch retained for reproduction.
candidate_decisions.gpu_tile: Benchmark only: restricted numerical proof and value-only throughput do not qualify full builder dispatch.
candidate_decisions.residency: Model retained separately; no public API or fresh-builder win claimed.
